products.name: DaVinci Resolve AI
products.note: Professional video AI; color grading; facial recognition; local processing option

profile_text.body:
Blackmagic Design is a hardware and software manufacturer serving the feature film, post-production, and broadcast industries. The company describes itself as creating products for those sectors, with its lineup spanning digital cinema cameras such as the URSA Cine series, live production switchers under the ATEM brand, the Fairlight Live audio mixer, HyperDeck recorders, network storage devices, and a range of conversion and capture products built around SMPTE-2110 and 100G Ethernet infrastructure.

The company's primary AI-relevant product is DaVinci Resolve, its professional video editing and color grading application. The tracked version, DaVinci Resolve AI, includes features described as covering color grading, facial recognition, and local processing. The site references DaVinci Resolve 21 as a current release alongside new hardware introductions.

The held facts record no litigation, no MCP servers, and no SEC or patent filings associated with Blackmagic Design. The company has an established profile page on theworldofai.org with DaVinci Resolve AI listed under the Video Generation and Editing category.
